base_member_text: icount (L21, L24) is incremented but unused
audit_member_text: `w_ang` and `icount` are calculated but never used (L21-L24,L57). Interactive nstart/nend are unvalidated, so reversed or nonexistent output ranges yield no plots or load failures.

base_member_text: caxis for panel 3 is set to [-12 0] (L75) then overridden to [-12 2.5] (L80); the intended range is ambiguous
audit_member_text: The two caxis calls for the depth subplot conflict: L75 sets [-12,0], then L80 overwrites it with [-12,2.5] on the same axes without intervening axes selection.

base_member_text: dep is masked in-place with the first snapshot's mask (L33) and never reloaded, so later snapshots inherit accumulated NaN holes from all previous masks
audit_member_text: `dep` is loaded once before the frame loop at L5, then destructively set to NaN under each frame's mask at L33. A cell dry in any early frame remains NaN in all later frames even if it becomes wet, so the depth panel accumulates the union of historical dry masks rather than showing the current mask.

the dashed line at x=140 (L67) presumably marks the bar/rip-channel location; derivation not in this file
